minSeverity.title: Minimum severity
minSeverity.description: The least severe level that is still reported. style (the default) reports everything ShellCheck finds; warning reports only errors and warnings.

exclude.title: Excluded paths
exclude.description: Shell scripts that are never checked. Globs over the path: * within a segment, ** across segments, ? one character. A pattern without / matches the file name alone, a pattern with / is anchored to the path root.

extraArgs.title: Extra ShellCheck arguments
extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to shellcheck before the file, e.g. --enable=all or -e SC1090,SC1091.
